cataloginventory_options_can_subtract.summary: Whether placing an order immediately reduces a product's stock quantity.
cataloginventory_options_can_subtract.usage: Controls whether Magento subtracts ordered quantities from stock the moment an order is placed. In most setups this should stay Yes so available quantity reflects open orders; set it to No only when an external system owns stock levels.

values.label: Yes
values.description: Ordered quantities are subtracted from stock when the order is placed.

values.label: No
values.description: Stock is left unchanged when an order is placed; quantities must be adjusted elsewhere.

cataloginventory_options_can_back_in_sto.summary: Whether cancelling an order can flip a product back to "In Stock".
cataloginventory_options_can_back_in_sto.usage: When an order is cancelled and its items return to stock, this decides whether a product that had dropped to Out of Stock is automatically set back to In Stock. Applies only while stock is being managed.

values.label: Yes
values.description: A cancelled order's returned quantity can move the product back to In Stock.

values.label: No
values.description: Stock status is left unchanged; the product stays Out of Stock until set manually.

cataloginventory_options_show_out_of_sto.summary: Whether out-of-stock products appear in category listings and search results.
cataloginventory_options_show_out_of_sto.usage:
When Yes, products with no available stock still appear in category pages, search and layered navigation. When No, they are hidden from listings but remain reachable by their direct product URL.

Changing this invalidates the catalog and search indexes, so the storefront keeps the previous behaviour until reindexing completes.

values.label: Yes
values.description: Out-of-stock products are listed and searchable.

values.label: No
values.description: Out-of-stock products are hidden from listings, but still reachable by direct URL.

cataloginventory_options_stock_threshold.summary: Quantity at or below which the storefront shows an "Only X left" message.
cataloginventory_options_stock_threshold.usage: Sets the low-stock quantity that triggers the Only X left urgency message on the product page. Set it to 0 to turn the message off entirely.

cataloginventory_options_display_product.summary: Whether the storefront shows a product's "In Stock" / "Out of Stock" availability.
cataloginventory_options_display_product.usage: Controls whether the stock-availability label is shown to shoppers on product pages. Setting it to No hides the availability line without changing how stock is tracked.

values.label: Yes
values.description: Shoppers see the In Stock / Out of Stock label.

values.label: No
values.description: The availability label is hidden from the storefront.

cataloginventory_options_not_available_m.summary: Which message shoppers see when they request more than the available quantity.
cataloginventory_options_not_available_m.usage: Chooses the wording shown when a customer tries to add more of a product than is in stock.

values.label: Only X of Y available
values.description: Tells the shopper exactly how many units are available.

values.label: Not enough items for sale
values.description: Shows a generic shortage message without naming the number available.

cataloginventory_item_options_manage_sto.summary: Master switch for whether Magento tracks inventory quantities at all.
cataloginventory_item_options_manage_sto.usage:
When Yes, Magento tracks quantities and enforces stock status for products that use the default settings. When No, products are always treated as available and quantity is ignored.

Changing this reprocesses the whole catalog, so it can take some time.

values.label: Yes
values.description: Inventory is tracked and stock status is enforced.

values.label: No
values.description: Stock is not tracked; products are always purchasable.

cataloginventory_item_options_backorders.summary: Whether customers can order more than the quantity in stock.
cataloginventory_item_options_backorders.usage:
Controls what happens when a shopper orders beyond available stock. Allowing backorders lets quantity fall below zero so the order is still accepted.

Changing this reprocesses the whole catalog, so it can take some time.

values.label: Allow Qty Below 0
values.description: Stock may go negative; orders are accepted with no notice to the customer.

values.label: Allow Qty Below 0 and Notify Customer
values.description: Backorders are accepted and the shopper is told the item is backordered.

cataloginventory_item_options_max_sale_q.summary: The largest quantity of a single product a customer may buy in one order.
cataloginventory_item_options_max_sale_q.usage: Caps how many of one product can be placed in the cart. Applies to products using the default inventory settings; a per-product value overrides it.

cataloginventory_item_options_min_qty.summary: The quantity at which a product is considered out of stock.
cataloginventory_item_options_min_qty.usage: When available stock drops to this number, the product is marked Out of Stock. A negative value — together with backorders — lets stock fall below zero while the product stays sellable.

cataloginventory_item_options_min_sale_q.summary: The smallest quantity of a product a customer must buy in one order.
cataloginventory_item_options_min_sale_q.usage: Sets the minimum quantity required to add a product to the cart. Can be set per customer group, and overridden per product.

cataloginventory_item_options_notify_sto.summary: The stock level at or below which a product is flagged as low on admin reports.
cataloginventory_item_options_notify_sto.usage: Sets the quantity that marks a product as low on stock for the admin Low Stock report and notifications. It does not affect whether the product can be sold.

cataloginventory_item_options_auto_retur.summary: Whether refunding an item automatically returns its quantity to stock.
cataloginventory_item_options_auto_retur.usage: When Yes, the Return to Stock option is ticked by default when a credit memo is created, so refunded quantities go back into inventory. Staff can still change it per credit memo.

values.label: Yes
values.description: Refunded quantities are returned to stock by default.

values.label: No
values.description: Refunded quantities are not returned unless chosen on the credit memo.

cataloginventory_item_options_enable_qty.summary: Whether products must be purchased in fixed multiples.
cataloginventory_item_options_enable_qty.usage: Turns on quantity increments, forcing shoppers to buy in multiples of the Qty Increments value below — for example, in packs of 6.

values.label: Yes
values.description: Quantities are restricted to multiples of the increment.

values.label: No
values.description: Any quantity may be ordered (subject to min and max).

cataloginventory_item_options_qty_increm.summary: The multiple in which a product must be purchased when increments are enabled.
cataloginventory_item_options_qty_increm.usage: The step size shoppers must order in — for example 6 means quantities of 6, 12, 18 and so on. Only applies when Enable Qty Increments is set to Yes.
